g.text: CE with full-rank B: fixed-order error and truncation bias
Orange box: post hoc best fixed order by absolute gap, including dense; not a learner. Each cell uses all 32 runs.
Failure gaps are +∞; all displayed cells have 0/32 failures. N excludes 512 burn-in transitions; colors saturate outside [0.002, 10].
